justification: Changes which properties are shown Ku-ring-gai Part 18 biodiversity rules: a new overlay layer, a lot-overlap flag in the property lookup, a new condition in the rules route, and a gate rule

falsifiable_check.command: pytest tests/test_greenweb_overlay.py tests/test_gate_rules.py; after release: a Ku-ring-gai lot partly on a Canopy Remnant patch (address point outside it) gets greenweb=true and sees Part 18
falsifiable_check.fails_when: the Greenweb layer disagrees with the council's own Part 18R.1 map sheets registered to the NSW cadastre (category areas within 1% of the registered polygons: core 3,141.6 ha, support 1,321.7, landscape 828.6, corridor 4,048.5, canopy 203.8), or a lot touching Greenweb is not flagged, or Part 18 rows reach a lot that does not touch it
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main Part 18's 129 served rows are layer 'generic' (shown to every Ku-ring-gai property), and gating them on the LEP biodiversity layer would hide them from ~166 ha of Canopy Remnant (82% of it outside that layer; measured 2026-10-20 by registering the council's 20 Greenweb sheets to the cadastre). No 'greenweb' overlay exists (0 rows).

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays (point-based flags), nsw_cadastre_lots, the council's Greenweb PDF sheets
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: registration error of a few metres can flag a neighbouring lot along a boundary (shown, not hidden); if the greenweb query fails the flag is unset and Part 18 is not shown (logged), as for the other overlays

functions.name: greenwebForPoint
functions.input: the address coordinates and a query function for the database
functions.output: the Greenweb categories the lot touches and whether the lot or only the point was used, or null
functions.if_none: null when not on Greenweb or coordinates are not finite; throws on a database error, which the caller logs

values.if_missing: greenweb not sent; the condition layer serves no Part 18 rows

queries.sql: GREENWEB_LOT_SQL: lots containing the point intersected with spatial_overlays layer_type='greenweb'
queries.purpose: find the Greenweb categories that any part of the property's lot overlaps

break_it.scenario: a lot only partly on a small canopy patch, address point outside it
break_it.what_happens: a point test would hide Part 18 from a bound lot
break_it.how: the lot polygon is intersected, not the point

break_it.scenario: the gate rule runs before the new code is deployed
break_it.what_happens: old code has no greenweb condition, so Part 18 would reach nobody
break_it.how: release order recorded: deploy, load layer, then apply gate

break_it.scenario: the greenweb database query errors during a page view
break_it.what_happens: flag unset, Part 18 not shown for that page view
break_it.how: accepted: same as the other overlays; logged

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — after deploy: load_greenweb_overlay.py --commit, then derive_precinct_keys.py --council ku_ring_gai --apply; check a canopy-remnant lot sees Part 18 and a lot off Greenweb does not
